verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships official CLIs for this loop. `ccloud` creates, manages and connects to Cloud clusters, and its `ccloud quickstart` command logs in and creates a cluster interactively. The `cockroach` binary (installable via Homebrew) runs local single-node or in-memory demo clusters and opens an interactive SQL shell. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inspection commands (listing or describing databases and schemas) from the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI-only workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: The `ccloud` tool is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that allows you to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters.
use the `ccloud quickstart` command to interactively log in and create a new CockroachDB Serverless cluster.
starts a temporary, in-memory CockroachDB cluster of one or more nodes, with or without a preloaded dataset, and opens an interactive SQL shell to the cluster.
A single-node cluster is appropriate for quick SQL testing or app development.
